INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.3.1 Handwriting.

2. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1 Reading for Information.

3. When practising Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1Reading Fluency.

4. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Listening for Information.

5. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Punctuation.

6. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Listening for Comprehension.

7. When practising Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Writing 3.3.1 Sequencing Ideas.

8. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Avoid speaking to classmates
   D. Mix random languages with no purpose

9. When practising Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 3.2.1 Reading for comprehension.

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening.

11. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 4.3.1 Creative Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 5.1.1 Expressing Self Creatively and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 5.2.1 Reading for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 5.3.1 Writing Sentences and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 6.1.1 Listening for Information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 6.2.1 Reading Fluency: Poetry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
